title: Chapter 740 - 740 Emperor Slayer; Surrender!

Chapter 740 - 740 Emperor Slayer; Surrender!

Chapter 740 - 740 Emperor Slayer; Surrender!

740 Emperor Slayer; Surrender!

The army behind the nine-headed flood dragon also emitted a stern aura.

The terrifying aura continued to gather and rushed towards Lin Fan.

“Hualala!”

Lin Fan’s clothes and hair were blown left and right.

His expression remained unchanged.

“Roar!”

In the next moment…

In the void, a flood dragon head was like the sun, shining with a blinding light as it charged towards Lin Fan.

Wherever it passed, the void was like a broken shadow, shattering.

It was tyrannical and terrifying to the extreme.

Lin Fan willed it and a red tassel spear appeared in his hand.

This… It was the Supreme Spear that he had obtained from the system, an Overlord-tier weapon.

He saw…

Lin Fan poked at the head of the flood dragon.

“God Slayer!”

In the void, a fiery red energy storm that spanned millions of miles immediately covered the sun-shaped flood dragon head, twisting and tearing it apart!

“Boom!”

A flood dragon’s head cracked.

“Humph!”

Nine-headed flood dragon, no!

At this moment, the eight-headed flood dragon let out a muffled groan, and all of its faces were filled with ruthlessness.

In the first exchange, he was actually at a disadvantage.

Moreover, he had suffered quite a bit.

He was furious!

“Roar!”

In the air, the remaining eight giant flood dragon heads roared at the same time. They released different colors, such as gold, green, white, gray, and purple. They shot out different energies, such as gold, wood, water, ice, earth, and lightning.

The energy continued to explode and expand, turning the entire void colorful.

In the next moment, the eight Flood Dragon heads flew towards Lin Fan from all directions.

At this moment, Lin Fan felt as though he was in a patch of darkness, alone and weak.

However, there was no fear on his face. In fact, he was still very calm.

He saw…

Lin Fan stretched out his right hand.

” Universe in a Palm!”

Starlight flashed, and the darkness instantly dissipated, revealing eight ferocious flood dragon heads flying toward him.

Suddenly, 30 Transcendence Golden Bodies appeared behind Lin Fan.

These Transcendence Golden Bodies were like a small stream that flowed into the sea, entering Lin Fan’s body.

“Buzz!”

Instantly, Lin Fan’s entire body expanded by tens of times and emitted a dazzling golden light.

Lin Fan clenched his right hand and the True Dragon Sword appeared.

“Sword Nurturing Technique!”

“Four Nine Swords!”

“Whoosh!”

The mighty sword qi rushed 90,000 miles and instantly cut off the head of the flood dragon at the front.

“Fifty Swords!”

Another sword Qi shot out and chopped off the flood dragon’s head on the left.

“Five Swords!”

“Sword 52!”

One sword was stronger than the other, chopping the flood dragon’s head like cutting vegetables!

In fact, this was normal.

Every Transcendence Golden Body contained the same energy as Lin Fan.

Thirty Transcendence Golden Bodies merged into one.

Its power was unimaginable!

The True Dragon Sword had long since become a treasured sword of the Imperial level.

Sword 81 was a powerful monarch level cultivation technique.

In addition, there was also the Emperor-grade Sword Nurturing Technique!

After a few layers, it could be said to be infinitely powerful.

….

In the distant void.

The First Elder and the other members of the Four Seasons Universe had been paying attention to the battle.

When they saw that Lin Fan had killed a King level 8 expert, they all exclaimed in shock.

“Just how strong is this Lin Fan?”

“That’s an expert at level 8 of the king class!”

“Could it be that he has already reached the Emperor level?”

….

When Lin Fan chopped off one of the heads of the Nine Headed Flood Dragon, cheers erupted out.

“Heavens! Ocean Universe Master had been beheaded!”

“That’s great. Perhaps we really have a chance to defeat the ocean universe!”

“Too strong!”

….

In contrast to the cheers of the crowd, the First Elder only watched silently with an extremely cold gaze.

When Lin Fan chopped off the heads of the nine flood dragons one after another, the First Elder finally opened his mouth and said,””Now! Let’s attack together and defeat the ocean universe army!”

“Yes, sir!” Everyone shouted in unison.

Their voices were filled with excitement!

Because they saw hope.

Everyone leaped out like meteors streaking across the sky and arrived at the battlefield in an instant.

At this moment, only two heads were left of the nine-headed flood dragon. It became even more ferocious and terrifying.

The Great Elder said to Lin Fan,” Star Lord Lin, we’re here to help you!””

Lin Fan just glanced at him and didn’t say anything.

He raised the True Dragon Sword again and slashed at the head of the nine-headed flood dragon.

At this moment, the First Elder behind Lin Fan suddenly took out a long blade and slashed at Lin Fan’s back.

“Boom!”

However, an invisible barrier suddenly appeared around Lin Fan and blocked it easily.

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to this. He continued to swing his sword and chopped off another head of the nine-headed flood dragon.

“You finally made your move?””

“You knew I was going to deal with you?” The long-faced man said with an ugly expression.

Lin Fan smiled but didn’t say anything.

How could he not know?

When he rejected the Great Elder from entering Earth, he already had 3 stars of hatred towards Lin Fan.

After Lin Fan had chopped off a few heads, the First Elder’s hatred towards Lin Fan had reached 6 stars.

The upper echelons of the Four Seasons Universe looked at the Great Elder in confusion.

“First Elder, you are…”

“What happened?”

“Great Elder, why is this?”

….

The First Elder’s expression changed, but he did not answer.

Lin Fan smiled,” You guys can’t tell?” Your great elder is in cahoots with the ocean universe!”

He saw…

Lin Fan’s eyes shone with a golden light. Another 20 Transcendence Golden Bodies appeared beside him and quickly fused into Lin Fan’s body.

“Sword Five Five!”

With a swing of his sword, the sword qi that filled the sky surged down like a tsunami.

The First Elder’s pupils constricted as he hurriedly dodged.

However, this sword Qi seemed to be endless. He could not dodge it even if he wanted to.

The First Elder was extremely shocked. He quickly formed a seal and formed a thick golden energy barrier in front of him.

However, the golden energy cloak was like paper, unable to block the mighty sword qi at all.

“Tsk!”

The golden energy shield and the First Elder cracked and shattered.

The Great Elder was dead!

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Killed a Level 4 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator. Obtained 40 billion experience points.]

The surging energy kept surging.

However, Lin Fan did not have any intentions of comprehending it. He turned around and looked at the nine-headed Flood Dragon with a pair of cold eyes.

Having eight heads chopped off consecutively, the nine flood dragons were already terrified of Lin Fan.

Now, seeing him kill the fourth level Martial Monarch Realm First Elder with one move, he was even more frightened.

“Yes… I’m sorry, I surrender. I’m willing to serve you as my master… Please don’t kill me…”

What responded to him was only a sharp sword qi.

“Tsk!”
